description: This file implements the WorkerThread class and related factory functions for managing a worker thread that processes tasks asynchronously in the Rialto server component.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread for executing queued tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WorkerThread.

methods.name: createWorkerThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WorkerThread instance.

methods.name: WorkerThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts the worker thread.

methods.name: ~WorkerThread
methods.description: Destructor that joins the worker thread if it is still running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the worker thread to stop processing tasks.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Waits for the worker thread to finish execution.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the queue for processing by the worker thread.

methods.name: taskHandler
methods.description: Main loop of the worker thread that processes tasks from the queue.

methods.name: waitForTask
methods.description: Blocks until a task is available in the queue and returns it.
